areas.name: Human rights
areas.reason: New municipal funeral infrastructure supports dignity and socio-spatial justice, with a related specific objective and indicator, but resources are low relative to the program and population impact is limited.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Paving, drainage, mobility and sanitation connections address disorderly urban growth and flooding; specific objective and indicators align; resources are significant and impact potential high.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Rehabilitation of sports gyms, courts and squares expands access to physical activity, with specific indicators and products; resources relevant but impact potential moderate.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Green infrastructure, nature-based solutions and a linear park contribute, with indicators, but sustainable use of the environment is cross-cutting rather than the main program impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Drainage works and nature-based solutions contribute but are not focused on risk management or adaptation, better fitted to sustainable cities and environment; indicators imprecise.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: An eco-industrial district component has a related objective and replicability potential, but the future industries were not specified, so impact was judged barely relevant.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: A municipal photovoltaic plant with a specific objective and indicators expands renewables, but it mainly cuts public-building energy costs, so impact on energy security is low.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: No actions found contributing to this strategic area.
